messages:
Nora (Finance): Heads-up from partner Parallax: they reported two identical promo credits on their May invoice INV-2026-2211. Can billing ops triage?
Evan (Acct Rep): Confirmed. Invoice shows PROMO-MAY-2026 $1,200 applied twice. Customer insists they only qualified once.
Sam (Billing Ops): I checked the backfill runs. We had a scheduled backfill that got stuck and the controller retried the job in a loop for ~7 mins. Looks like credits were applied twice with the same promo code but no dedupe guard.
Sam (Billing Ops): Excerpt from job log: 
```
2026-05-11T02:10:04Z promo-backfill run=pb-20260511 acct=prt-221 apply_credit promo=PROMO-MAY-2026 amt=1200 token=tok-3a
2026-05-11T02:10:04Z promo-backfill run=pb-20260511 acct=prt-221 apply_credit promo=PROMO-MAY-2026 amt=1200 token=tok-3a attempts=2
```
Evan (Acct Rep): Customer is worried about charges flipping on their statement if we reverse.
Nora (Finance): Policy: reverse accidental duplicate promo credits but offer clear comms and a goodwill safety net if reversal causes issues. For this case: post a reversal for $1,200 with code REV-PROMO-BACKFILL and notify the customer. If they report dispute, we can issue a goodwill credit to make them whole. Tag rc=promo-backfill-loop.
Sam (Billing Ops): Queuing reversal: `vb adjust-reversal --acct prt-221 --amount 1200 --currency USD --invoice INV-2026-2211 --code REV-PROMO-BACKFILL --note "duplicate promo from backfill loop"`
recon-bot: Action queued: reversal_pending | id=BILL-7432 | acct=prt-221 | amt=1200 USD
Sam (Billing Ops): Reversal posted txn=RV-2026-A7C2. Added note and rc tag promo-backfill-loop.
Evan (Acct Rep): Sent customer note: "We found a duplicate promo credit on INV-2026-2211 caused by a backfill controller retry loop. We've posted a reversal of $1,200 (txn RV-2026-A7C2). This will appear on your next statement as a reversal line. If the reversal causes any billing or payment issues, please reply and we'll make it right."
Nora (Finance): Thanks. Please add a mitigation card: make backfill idempotent using per-account idempotency tokens and add a retry cap. Close when ledger reconciles.
Evan (Acct Rep): Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick note. No issues on our side; appreciated." :thumbsup:
